name: ciphersar
description: Adaptive, explainable AML investigation agent for financial institutions.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @ciphersar/api" "npm run dev -w @ciphersar/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ciphersar/shared && npm run build -w @ciphersar/api && npm run build -w @ciphersar/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ciphersar/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ciphersar/api && npm run typecheck -w @ciphersar/web
